summary: ParaZero Technologies filed a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing receipt of a Nasdaq minimum bid price deficiency notice. The company has 180 days, until November 2, 2026, to regain compliance by having its ordinary shares close at $1.00 or more for ten consecutive business days. Failure may lead to an additional 180-day period if eligibility criteria are met, or eventual delisting. There are no deal terms or transaction involved; this is a routine listing compliance notification, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are provided. Watch for potential reverse stock split or other cures to maintain listing.
